# Decision Memo: Vendor Selection for Year One

**To:** CFO
**From:** Priya, Procurement
**Re:** Vendor recommendation for year-one contract
**Decision needed:** Approval before signing

## Recommendation

Approve **Vendor Alpha**.

## Evaluation Against Constraints

| Criterion | Alpha | Beta |
|---|---|---|
| Year-one cost (subscription + setup) | $92,000 | $70,000 |
| Budget ceiling ($100,000 incl. setup) | Pass | Pass |
| SSO (mandatory before production) | Available | Unavailable, no committed delivery date |
| Other stated requirements | Met | Met |

## Analysis

Both vendors fit within the year-one budget ceiling of $100,000 including setup. Alpha totals $92,000 ($72,000 subscription + $20,000 setup); Beta totals $70,000 ($60,000 subscription + $10,000 setup). Beta is $22,000 cheaper.

However, SSO is mandatory before production. Alpha has SSO available today. Beta cannot provide SSO and has no committed delivery date, meaning Beta cannot support production go-live on any reliable timeline. Despite the cost advantage, Beta fails a mandatory constraint; cost savings cannot compensate for a hard requirement gap with unbounded schedule risk.

Alpha satisfies all constraints within budget, leaving an $8,000 margin under the ceiling.

## Risks

- Alpha consumes 92% of the year-one budget ceiling, leaving limited room for unforeseen costs.
- Beta risk is disqualifying: no SSO and no committed delivery date means production timing is vendor-dependent and unverifiable.

## Requested Action

Approve Vendor Alpha at $92,000 year-one total cost, contingent on your sign-off before contract execution.
